derived.label: reference length D
derived.note: chord = 2.6 D for the airfoil; fixed by the silhouette for vehicles/text; scales with resolution

derived.label: viscosity ν = (τ−½)/3
derived.note: recomputed so Re = U·D/ν holds at the chosen speed

derived.label: relaxation time τ
derived.note: τ close to 0.5 is under-resolved (use a lower Re or higher speed)

derived.label: elapsed convective time U·t/D
derived.note: D grows with resolution while the step count does not, so a resolution change shortens this: increase the duration to keep the same physical interval

plots.title: Lift signal
plots.explain: Transverse velocity at a point in the wake (wake probe, sampled every lattice step); its oscillation is the alternating side force of vortex shedding. Units: lattice velocity. Source: the solver's wake probe written every step, after the first 20 % of the run (start-up transient removed).

plots.title: Strouhal spectrum
plots.explain: Fourier spectrum of the probe signal (Hann window). The peak frequency f made dimensionless with the reference length D and inflow speed U is the Strouhal number St = f·D/U. A value is only reported when the record holds at least six shedding cycles with a clear peak.
